observations: Q2 revenue was $3.8B, up 3% y/y; first-half revenue was up $500M or 7% y/y.
Management reiterated 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $6.40-$6.60 and manufacturing cash-flow-before-pension guidance of $700M-$800M.
Bell Q2 backlog was $7.5B and Textron Systems backlog $3.3B; management reported MV-75 long-lead production progress.
Textron initiated a sale process for Industrial after announcing intent to separate it, aiming to become a more focused aerospace-and-defense platform.
risks: Q2 manufacturing operating cash flow fell versus prior year
Industrial separation execution and valuation uncertainty
defense program mix and commercial delivery cyclicality
unknowns: final structure/timing/value realization of Industrial separation
durability of Aviation order strength through a downturn

recommendation.reason: Fresh issuer evidence supplies current execution, backlog, guidance and portfolio-transition inputs; numeric underwriting remains Alpha-owned.
